Golden Designs 4-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF Infrared Sauna with Himalayan Salt

Elevate your home wellness experience with the Golden Designs 4-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF Infrared Sauna. Crafted from premium Canadian Hemlock wood, this sauna offers both quality and style, transforming any indoor space into a personal spa sanctuary.

The Golden Designs 4-person infrared sauna integrates Full Spectrum infrared technology to deliver near, mid, and far infrared wavelengths.

Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna – An Unmatched Home Wellness Experience

The Golden Designs 4-Person Infrared Sauna is equipped with a comprehensive Full Spectrum heating system. This system uses 9 advanced heaters, including 3 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR infrared panels and 6 near-infrared elements. The near zero EMF technology ensures a safe, efficient sauna experience, making it ideal for health-conscious users.

Why Choose the Golden Designs 4-Person Infrared Sauna?

  • Full Spectrum Heating Technology – This sauna combines near, mid, and far infrared heat to deliver comprehensive therapeutic benefits.
  • Himalayan Salt Therapy – Built-in Himalayan salt bars purify the air, support respiratory health, and create a tranquil environment.
  • Near Zero EMF Technology – The heating panels produce under 2MG of EMF, ensuring a safe and healthy sauna session.
  • Spacious 4-Person Design – Comfortably accommodates up to four people, making it perfect for families or group relaxation.
  • Smart Controls & Entertainment – Includes a touchscreen control panel, Bluetooth connectivity, MP3 auxiliary input, and built-in speakers.

The Golden Designs sauna is a perfect blend of innovation, quality, and luxury. It provides a personalized wellness retreat in the comfort of your home.

Key Features of the Golden Designs Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna

1. Advanced Full Spectrum Heating System

The Golden Designs 4-person sauna utilizes Full Spectrum infrared technology to deliver comprehensive heat therapy. This system includes 9 total heaters, strategically positioned for maximum coverage and efficiency. Three FAR infrared panels provide deep heat penetration, while six near-infrared elements target surface-level warmth.

2. Himalayan Salt Therapy for Enhanced Wellness

This sauna is equipped with two Himalayan salt bars, positioned above the rear wall and below the bench. These salt bars release negative ions, which purify the air, enhance breathing, and promote relaxation. The integration of Himalayan salt therapy sets this sauna apart, offering benefits typically found in luxury spas.

3. Near Zero EMF Heating Panels

Safety is a top priority with the Golden Designs sauna. The PureTech™ heating panels are engineered to emit less than 2MG of EMF at a typical seating distance. This ensures that you can enjoy your sauna sessions without exposure to excessive electromagnetic fields.

4. Luxurious Design and Features

Constructed from natural Canadian Hemlock, this sauna is both durable and attractive. The bronze-tinted tempered glass door offers privacy, while the interior design includes oversized chromotherapy lighting and a red light therapy feature. The touch screen control panel provides easy access to temperature and lighting adjustments, and the built-in speakers let you enjoy music via Bluetooth or MP3 connection.

Looking for a Different Sauna Size?

If you’re looking for a more compact option, consider our Golden Designs 3-Person Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna for similar features in a smaller footprint.

Specifications & Electrical Requirements

  • Capacity: 4-Person
  • Dimensions: 75” H x 70” W x 46” D
  • Heating System: 9 heaters (3 FAR IR Carbon Panels + 6 Near Infrared Elements)
  • Himalayan Salt Bars: 2 (above rear wall and below the bench)
  • Control System: Touchscreen LED control panel
  • Lighting System: Chromotherapy and red light therapy
  • Audio System: Bluetooth, FM station, and MP3 auxiliary input with built-in speakers
  • Electrical Requirements: 120V, 20A standard plug, dedicated circuit recommended

Invest in Your Health and Wellness

The Golden Designs 4-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF Infrared Sauna is a comprehensive wellness solution that offers both luxury and functionality. With its Full Spectrum heating, Himalayan salt therapy, and premium features, this sauna is an excellent investment for your health.
